sources.fact: OS NGD is Ordnance Survey's authoritative structured geospatial database with Select+Build and API access routes.
OS NGD API – Features uses OGC API – Features and supports spatial/attribute/time filtering for detailed geometries.
Features endpoints include collection/schema/queryables/features; CQL includes INTERSECTS spatial filtering.
Feature collections are exposed by theme/collection/feature type through the NGD Features API.
Buildings theme provides permanent roofed construction geometry and embedded height attribution for Building/Building Part features.
Building Features offers up-to-daily updates and detailed building attribution.
Land theme contains point/line/polygon land-cover features and separates building, structure, land-use, transport and water collections.
Land-use site extents describe activity and access, but OS explicitly says they must not be regarded as legal extents or ownership.
Structure Features include point/line/polygon geometries such as bridges, field boundaries, sea walls and other non-building structures.
Transport Features provides detailed physical transport geometries with persistent identifiers and up-to-daily updates.
Transport Network provides link/node connectivity for roads, rail, ferry and path networks; it is distinct from legal site access rights.
Water Features includes topographic polygon/point water features, generally in British National Grid, with up-to-daily updates for many feature types.

examples.result: OS NGD building geometry is used for physical-footprint context, not ownership/title extent.
Land-use Site extents are never promoted as legal parcel boundaries because OS explicitly distinguishes them from ownership extents.
Building height attribution is not converted into planning height permission or development capacity.
Transport network connectivity is not treated as legal vehicular/pedestrian access to a title.
Field boundary/structure geometry is not assumed to equal a legal boundary.
Water topography is kept distinct from EA statutory flood-risk layers.
OGC INTERSECTS/API availability is acquisition readiness only until candidate-specific queries are executed and archived.
No parcel promotion occurs from OS NGD without exact HMLR title relation and current planning/statutory evidence.
